title: Buck Owens built a palace for it
text: In 1996 Buck Owens opened the Crystal Palace in Bakersfield, a nightclub for country performers and a museum of his own career under one roof. The building on Buck Owens Boulevard was built in a Western Revival style, made to look like the Old West, and the museum filled display cases around the ground floor. After nearly thirty years, it closed in August 2025.
